content.short: Rampnow is a non-custodial technology layer connecting apps and wallets to onramps across 60+ chains.
content.description: Rampnow sits between applications and the underlying onramp and offramp providers, offering one non-custodial integration that reaches across more than sixty networks. Monad's documentation lists it among onramps. The aggregation layer exists because provider coverage varies sharply by country and payment method, so no single onramp serves a global user base well.
